author: The Spiffing Brit
description:
Hello one and all and welcome to a rather silly video of stellaris! Now stellaris is normally a deeply serious sci fi space 4x grand strategy game with real time fleet combat and a deep realistic simulation of what running a grand space empire might actually be. And look I know GTA 6 is out but why be happy robbing people and cars when you can rob entire planets. 

Now today I (the spiffing brit) intend to showcase how not to play the game as instead of building up a normal peaceful empire and exploring the galaxy we instead are playing as the mobile nomadic British empire that is going around the galaxy blowing things up and stealing every single artifact we can find to chuck inside our space British museum. This strategy lets us exploit the AI into allowing us conquer the galaxy, be unstoppable in combat and most important of all... Generate INFINITE RESOURSCES! title: The British Way Of Playing Stellaris - A PERFECTLY BALANCED GAME WITH NO EXPLOITS!
